scores.overall_cap_derivation: ceil1(26,127 / 479,014 * 10) = ceil1(0.545) = 0.6, plus at most +1.0 for the pre-manifest app = 1.6. scores.round_files_fidelity_rationale: Good: paramfile::save now formats and parses in the same culture, so de-DE no longer turns 0.135 into 135. target_for/offset_from_leader return None on a ProjNet exception. follower_command returns None before touching guided/pids, matching the C# catch that skips the rest of the follower's try block (a missing offsets[mav] key also lands there through '?'), and update_positions aborts the whole click as the escaping exception does. The doc comments now describe the C# correctly. Enter UTM Coord matches enterUTMCoordToolStripMenuItem_Click's order: zone digits via ToLower().Replace('s',' ').Replace('n',' '), int.Parse/double.Parse in the current culture, Hemisphere.South always (the C# Contains("N") after ToLower never matches), GeoUtility's UTMWGS series, and nothing is added on an exception. on_event/write_prompts_ui reproduce WPtoScreen -> processToScreen for all three types, and an empty list clears the target list and returns early, as C# does at FlightPlanner.cs:5518-5524. Lost: the param file text is G15 of the widened float, not MAVLinkParam.ToString()'s float G7 (ConfigRawParams.cs:594/661 -> MAVLinkParam.cs:219-224), so every fractional REAL32 line differs from what Mission Planner writes; save() still returns an empty string on an exception; the download queue processes downloads that C# never sends to WPtoScreen and is deferred until the planner's action panel is drawn; swarm errors go to log::error with the message only, not Console.WriteLine("Failed to send command " + mav + "\n" + ex) and not the unhandled-exception dialog for Update Pos; Enter UTM errors are a toast rather than the unhandled-exception dialog, FlightPlanner.zone is only remembered when all three boxes are confirmed, and new_wp is not setfromMap(lat, lng, 0) (no Absolute verify-height branch, no (int) SRTM truncation, own home instead of PlannedHomeLocation, full-precision lat/lng instead of "0.0000000" cell text). All round-62 carry-overs (cell model, home text, multipliers, setWPParams, markers/polygons, sticky Stroke) are unchanged.

low_confidence_risks: crates/mp-app/src/views/flight_plan.rs:2409-2412 (test, probable runtime failure, not a compile error): the edited Easting text is east + 1000 rounded to 0.001 m, and the Northing that coords_from_cells parses is coord_cells' 0.001 m text (flight_plan.rs:1131/1159), but the expected point uses the unrounded east + 1000 and north. Up to 0.0005 m of rounding is about 4.5e-9 deg of latitude and 5.5e-9 deg of longitude at 35 S, above the 1e-9 tolerance, so the assert fails unless both projections happen to fall within about 0.0001 m of a millimetre. Compute the expected value from the parsed cell texts (double_parse of the same strings), or relax the tolerance to 1e-8.

findings.summary: The R62-02 fix stops the comma-culture corruption but uses the wrong text. The Hashtable double in C# is double.Parse of the grid cell, and the cell holds MAVLinkParam.ToString(), which for a REAL32 parameter is the float's G7 text. So 0.135f is saved as 'ATC_RAT_RLL_P,0.135'. Rust widens the f32 to f64 and formats G15, so the same parameter is saved as 'ATC_RAT_RLL_P,0.135000005364418'. Every fractional parameter in every saved .param file now differs from Mission Planner's output; round 62's format_value happened to match here. save() still returns an empty string on an exception, where the C# StreamWriter keeps the lines written before it (R62-02 asked for this). format_value ({:.7} trimmed, invariant) is still the displayed cell text in config.rs and friendly.rs. mavlog.rs:212's Extract Params goes through SaveParamFile (comma, sorted, G15 invariant), while MavlinkLog writes 'name<TAB>' + MAVLinkParam.ToString() in MAV.param key order. The roundtrip test cannot catch any of this because it compares f32 values after reloading.

verdict: A narrow fix round with no definite compile errors. The four targeted findings were addressed: comma-decimal locales no longer corrupt saved parameters, swarm followers are no longer sent to the leader's position on a transform error, Enter UTM Coord uses GeoUtility and .NET parsing, and FENCE/RALLY and empty downloads go through processToScreen. Two of the fixes are imprecise copies of the C#. The param file now holds G15 text of the widened float (0.135000005364418) where Mission Planner writes the float's own text (0.135). The download queue sends every mission download to the planner, including Flight Data's Resume Mission and the connect-time rally fetch, which C# keeps out of the planner. The rewritten UTM test will most likely fail on millimetre rounding. No owned files were ported, so progress stays at about 5.5% (26,127 / 479,014) and the cap stays 1.6. Awarded 1.3; round-file fidelity 6.3; UI/UX 2.2; features 3.1.
